title: Predicting Credit Card Fraud
headline: We are in the top few hundred of about a thousand teams on the public board and our best entry scores about as well as the leaders. We are widening the set of models we blend and have until the end of November to send final entries.

board.note: The place was read on 7 November before our later entries; the best score is from our ninth entry the same day, so today's place is likely better than the one shown.

entries.note: Count is the entries logged in the ledger on main as of 7 November; entries used today are not recorded there. The daily limit of ten is from the contest rules page read on 1 November.

next: Run the full-recipe language-model member on one fold of rented cards to see if it adds to the blend.
Keep scouting public notebooks and prediction banks and blend in any that check out on our own validation split.
